The following events took place in '''33 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Yinchorri Uprising]].<ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] replaces [[Micah Giiett]] on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] after the latter's [[Death/Legends|death]].
*In defiance of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] resumes the taxation of trade in the [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zone]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Eriadu Trade Summit]].<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref><ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], a leader of the Trade Federation under [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] orders, has the other six representatives killed, thus allowing the Trade Federation to be only controlled by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], and with the affiliation of the [[Gran/Legends|Grans]].
*[[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] becomes the leading representative of the Trade Federation.
*In response to a wave of [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] attacks, the Galactic Senate grants the Trade Federation the right to arm its ships, in return for [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] taxation.
*Republic exploration ship ''[[Pathfinder III]]'' rediscovers [[Yashuvhu/Legends|Yashuvhu]].
*[[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] becomes the new [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
*The [[Foreign Affairs scandal]]<ref name="ASD">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], former [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], becomes elected [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. ('''ReSynchronization Date 2:10''')<ref name="TNEC" />
*The [[Coronation of Queen Amidala/Legends|Coronation of Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="TNEC" />
*Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] disbands terrorist organization [[The Flail]].<ref name="SOC">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']], it is incorrectly stated that [[Alexi Garyn]] died thirteen years before [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], placing it in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].
